Transliteration convention: ś = ሠ-series, ʿ = ዐ-series, ə = 6th order, 1st order ä, 4th order a. Translations made fresh from the Geʿez; Dillmann's Lexicon (1865) the lexical aid.
about: Zadok the priest charges David, Solomon's son and the new king of Ethiopia, to hear the word of God. He sets out the curses for disobedience, closely following Deuteronomy 28 (barren fields, hunger, a brazen sky, defeat, plague, loss of wife, house, vineyard and children), then the blessings for obedience, and ends by praising God as lord of death and life. Several disease names and a few rare words are uncertain and marked (?).

sentences.i: If you do it, you will live for God. But if you do not do it, God will strike you; you will be left lacking beside all the peoples (?), you will be beaten by your enemy, and he will turn his face from you. You will be dismayed, grieved and sick in your heart, and your sleep also will be without rest or health.
sentences.n: ለእመ 'if' + perfect (ገበርከ 'you did/do'); ተሐዩ 'you will live' (ሐይወ; the spelling with ተ- is not the usual ትሕዮ, so the form is read as 2nd masc. sing. (?)). ወለእመሰ: the enclitic -ሰ marks the contrast, 'but if'. ይቀሥፈከ 'he will scourge you' (ቀሠፈ, imperfect + object suffix). ሕጹጸ is the accusative of ሕጹጽ 'lacking'; እምነ may be 'than' (so 'inferior to all peoples') or 'from among', and 'left lacking beside all peoples' is a guess (?). ትትመዋእ 'you will be overcome', from ተመዋዐ (?). ድንጉፅ, ሕዙን, ሕሙም are predicate adjectives (accusative, ending in -ä). ንዋምከኒ: the enclitic -ኒ 'also'. The curses echo Deuteronomy 28:20-25, 65-66 loosely.

sentences.n: Two imperatives (ስማዕ, ግበር) and two prohibitions with ኢ- + imperfect (ኢትትገሐሥ 'do not turn aside', ኢታምልክ 'do not worship', a verb made from አምላክ 'god'). ንኤዝዘከ is the 1st plural 'we command you'. glossary.ተሐዩ: ሐይወ — you will live (2ms imperfect, ḥ-y-w; written ተሐዩ, not the usual ትሕዮ, so the parse is uncertain (?)) (?)
glossary.ትሬኢ: ርእየ — she sees (3fs imperfect, G) · 2ms 'you see' (ትሬኢ በአዕይንቲከ 'you will see with your eyes')
glossary.ትብል: ብህለ — she says (3fs imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying') · 2ms 'you say' (ሶበ ጸብሐ ትብል 'when it is morning you say')
glossary.ትነትዕ: ነትዐ — you will flee (2ms imperfect, G, n-t-ʿ) (?)
glossary.ትከውን: ኮነ — you will be (2ms imperfect) · also 3fs 'she/it becomes, is' (እንተ ትከውን ሲሳየ 'which is food')
glossary.ትወፅእ: ወፅአ — you will go out (2ms imperfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, with (preposition) · 'where' as a place conjunction (ኀበ ትነብር 'where she dwells'; ch. 17–19 headings) · how (in a chapter heading: ኀበ መከረ ንጉሥ 'how the king took counsel'; ኀበ አንገሥዎ 'how they enthroned him') · toward (ኀበ ኵሉ ዘአንጸርከ 'toward all that you face')
glossary.ኀቤሆሙ: ኀበ — to them (preposition ኀበ, stem ኀቤ- + -ሆሙ '3mp')
glossary.ንኤዝዘከ: አዘዘ — we command you (1cp imperfect, G, ʾ-z-z, + -ከ 'you')
glossary.አህጉረ: ሀገር — cities (noun; plural አህጉር, accusative form)
glossary.አማልክተ: አምላክ — gods (noun; plural አማልክት, accusative form)
glossary.አምላከ: አምላክ — God of (noun, construct) · also accusative 'a god' (ካልአ አምላከ 'another god')
glossary.አክበሮ: አክበረ — he honoured him (3ms perfect, causative, + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.አድገከ: አድግ — your ass, asses (noun, collective or plural + -ከ '2ms your', accusative)
glossary.ኢለየማን: የማን — not to the right (ኢ- + ለ- + noun 'right hand, right')
glossary.ኢሰማዕከ: ሰምዐ — you did not hear, obey (ኢ- + 2ms perfect)
glossary.ኢታአምር: አእመረ — you do not know (ኢ- + 2ms imperfect, causative, ʾ-ʿ-m-r)
glossary.ኢገበርከ: ገብረ — you did not (ኢ- + 2ms perfect, g-b-r)
glossary.እምቅድመ: ቅድመ — before, prior to · 'from before' (እምቅድመ ገጾሙ 'from before their faces')
glossary.እምብዝኀተ: ብዝኀት — from, because of the abundance of (እም- + noun, construct)
glossary.እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')
glossary.እምነ: እምነ — from (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · from among (እምነ ኴሉ ነጋድያን 'from among all the merchants'; 'apart from' is also possible there) · than, in comparison (ጥበብ ትኄይስ እምነ ኴሉ 'wisdom is better than all')
glossary.እምኔከ: እም — from you (preposition እም with suffix -ኔከ '2ms')
glossary.እምዘ: ዘ — from him who (እም- + relative pronoun) · 'beyond what' (እምዘ ኢተሐዘብኩ 'beyond what I had expected') · 'from what' (እምዘ ንኤዝዘከ 'from what we command you')
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as, up to (preposition) · conjunction 'until' before a subjunctive (እስከ ይትፌጸም 'until might be fulfilled')
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16) · እንዘ ይብል 'saying' introducing speech (ch. 36)
glossary.ከሊአ: ከልአ — to prevent, hinder (infinitive, G, k-l-ʾ; accusative)
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay')
glossary.ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ወለእመ: እመ — and if (ወ- + ለእመ, conditional conjunction)
glossary.ወለእመሰ: እመ — and if indeed, but if (ወ- + ለእመ + enclitic -ሰ contrastive)
glossary.ወለፀርከ: ፀር — and to your enemy (ወ- + ለ- + ፀር + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ወሕሙመ: ሕሙም — and sick (ወ- + adjective; accusative predicate)
glossary.ወሕዙነ: ሕዙን — and grieved, sorrowful (ወ- + adjective; accusative predicate)
glossary.ወመራዕየ: መርዔት — and pastures of (ወ- + plural መራዕይ of መርዔት, construct, accusative)
glossary.ወበመቅሠፍተ: መቅሠፍት — and with the scourge, plague of (ወ- + በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወበመዝራዕቱ: መዝራዕት — and by his arm (ወ- + በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his', written -ቱ after ት)
glossary.ወበስብዕ: ሰብዓ — and by seven (ወ- + በ- + numeral 'seven', spoken ሰብዓ (säbʿa); here before ፍናው)
glossary.ወበክሂሎቱ: ክሂሎት — and by his power (ወ- + በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his', written -ቱ after ት)
glossary.ወበዐዊር: ዐዊር — and with blindness (ወ- + በ- + noun)
glossary.ወበድንጋፄ: ድንጋፄ — and with bewilderment, terror of (ወ- + በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወበፈፀንት: ፈፀንት — and with wasting (?) (ወ- + በ- + noun; sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወብድብደ: ብድብድ — and confusion, ruin (?) (ወ- + noun; accusative; sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወታረመስስ: ረመሰሰ — and you will grope (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, quadriliteral, r-m-s-s; the ታ- prefix is unexplained) (?)
glossary.ወታወስብ: አውሰበ — and you will betroth, take as wife (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, causative of ወሰበ; of a man taking a wife)
glossary.ወትተክል: ተከለ — and you will plant (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, G, t-k-l)
glossary.ወትትመዋእ: ተመዋዐ — and you will be overcome (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, tD-stem; root m-w-ʿ) (?)
glossary.ወትትቀተል: ተቀትለ — and you will be killed (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, tG passive of ቀተለ)
glossary.ወትነድቅ: ነደቀ — and you will build (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, G, n-d-q)
glossary.ወትከውን: ኮነ — and you will be (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, k-w-n; the same letters could be 3fs 'she', see the unit note)
glossary.ወትኴንን: ኰነነ — and you will rule, judge (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, G, k-ʷ-n-n)
glossary.ወትወርስ: ወርሰ — and you will inherit (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, G, w-r-s)
glossary.ወንዋምከኒ: ንዋም — and your sleep also (ወ- + noun + -ከ '2ms your' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
glossary.ወአብድንቲከኒ: አብድንት — and your corpses also (ወ- + plural noun, 'corpse(s)' (?) + -ከ '2ms your' + enclitic -ኒ 'also') (?)
glossary.ወአዋልዲከ: ወለት — and your daughters (ወ- + plural አዋልድ + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ወአውሥአ: አውሥአ — and he answered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
glossary.ወኢለፀጋም: ፀጋም — and not to the left (ወ- + ኢ- + ለ- + noun 'left')
glossary.ወኢታምልክ: አምለከ — and do not worship (ወ- + ኢ- + 2ms jussive of አምለከ, a verb made from አምላክ 'god': 'worship, serve as god')
glossary.ወኢትረክብ: ረክበ — and you will not find (ወ- + ኢ- + 2ms imperfect, G, r-k-b)
glossary.ወኢትቀሥም: ቀሠመ — and you will not taste (ወ- + ኢ- + 2ms imperfect, G, q-ś-m)
glossary.ወኢትበልዕ: በልዐ — and you will not eat (ወ- + ኢ- + 2ms imperfect, G, b-l-ʿ)
glossary.ወኢትትገሐሥ: ተገሐሠ — and do not turn aside (ወ- + ኢ- + 2ms imperfect/jussive, tG-stem, g-ḥ-ś) (?)
glossary.ወኢትነብር: ነብረ — and you will not dwell (ወ- + ኢ- + 2ms imperfect, G, n-b-r)
glossary.ወኢትክል: ክህለ — and you will not be able (ወ- + ኢ- + 2ms imperfect, G, k-h-l)
glossary.ወኢያገብኡ: አገብአ — and they will not return, restore (ወ- + ኢ- + 3mp subjunctive, causative of ገብአ)
glossary.ወዓልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not, none (ወ- + ዓልቦ, written with ዓ-)
glossary.ወዓዕጻደ: ዐጸድ — and enclosures, pens of (ወ- + plural ዓዕጻድ, construct, accusative)
glossary.ወየሀይደካሃ: ሀይደ — and he will seize her from you (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, h-y-d, + -ከ 'you' + -ሃ 'her')
glossary.ወየሀይዱ: ሀይደ — and they will drive off, seize (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, h-y-d)
glossary.ወያፈቅሮ: አፍቀረ — and he loves him (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, ʾ-f-q-r, + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወይመልክ: መልከ — and he rules (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, m-l-k)
glossary.ወይመይጥ: ሜጠ — and he will turn (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, m-y-ṭ; 'turn away')
glossary.ወይሬስዮ: ረሰየ — and he will make it (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, r-s-y, + -ዮ 'it')
glossary.ወይቀሥፈከ: ቀሠፈ — and he will scourge you (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, q-ś-f, + -ከ 'you')
glossary.ወይበልዕ: በልዐ — and he will eat (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, b-l-ʿ)
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይነ: ወይን — wine (noun, accusative) · 'vine' (ትተክል ወይነ 'you will plant a vine')
glossary.ወይከውነከ: ኮነ — and it will be to you (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, k-w-n, + dative -ነከ 'to you')
glossary.ወይገብኡ: ገብአ — and they return (ወ- + 3mp imperfect) · 'and they will pass over' (ወይገብኡ ደቂቅከ ለካልእ ሕዝብ 'and your sons will pass over to another people') (?)
glossary.ወይገብእ: ገብአ — and it will return, pass (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
glossary.ወይጠብሑ: ጠብሐ — and they will slaughter (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, ṭ-b-ḥ; impersonal)
glossary.ወይጠፍእ: ጠፍአ — and it will perish (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, ṭ-f-ʾ)
glossary.ወይፌኑ: ፈነወ — and he would send (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G; habitual 'would send') · 'and he will send' with God as subject, future (ወይፌኑ እግዚኣብሔር ረኃበ 'and God will send hunger'; 3ms of this third-weak verb, though it looks plural)
glossary.ወድንጉፀ: ድንጉፅ — and stunned, dazed (ወ- + adj., accusative)
glossary.ወጻማከ: ጻማ — and your toil, labour (ወ- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ውስቴቱ: ውስተ — within it, in it (preposition ውስተ, stem ውስቴ- + 3ms suffix -ቱ)
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he (3m sg independent pronoun) · also demonstrative 'that' before a noun (በውስተ ውእቱ ሥዕለ 'in that image') and copula 'it is' after a predicate (ጽድቅ ውእቱ 'true it is')
glossary.ዘለዓለም: ለዓለም — everlasting, eternal (ዘ- 'of' + ለዓለም 'for ever'; ክብረ ዘለዓለም 'glory of eternity')
glossary.ዘትክል: ክህለ — what you can (ዘ- + 2ms imperfect, G, k-h-l; written ትክል)
glossary.ዘእነግረከ: ነገረ — what I tell you (ዘ- 'that which' + 1cs imperfect, G, n-g-r, + -ከ 'you')
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered')
glossary.ዘኵሎ: ኵሉ — who (over) all (ዘ- + ኵሉ accusative; ዘኵሎ ይመልክ 'who rules all')
glossary.ዘወደይከ: ወደየ — that you set, put (ዘ- 'that which' + 2ms perfect, G, w-d-y, + -ከ; ዘወደይከ እዴከ 'what you put your hand to')
glossary.ዘይረክበከ: ረክበ — what will find, befall you (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, G, r-k-b, + -ከ 'you')
glossary.ዘይረድአከ: ረድአ — who helps you (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, G, r-d-ʾ, + -ከ 'you')
glossary.ዘይቀብረከ: ቀበረ — who buries you (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, G, q-b-r, + -ከ 'you')
glossary.ዝርወ: ዝርው — scattered, dispersed (adjective/participle of ዘርወ; accusative predicate) (?)
glossary.ያከብሮ: አክበረ — he honours him (3ms imperfect, causative of ከብረ, + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ያጠፍአከ: አጥፍአ — he destroys you (3ms subjunctive, causative of ጠፍአ, + -ከ 'you')
glossary.ይመልክ: መልከ — he rules, reigns over (3ms imperfect, G, m-l-k)
glossary.ይመሲ: መሰየ — it will be evening (3ms subjunctive, G, m-s-y)
glossary.ይቀሥፈከ: ቀሠፈ — he will scourge, strike you (3ms imperfect, G, q-ś-f, + -ከ 'you')
glossary.ይኤዝዝ: አዘዘ — he commands (3ms imperfect, G, ʾ-z-z; the አ- is a root letter, not a causative prefix)
glossary.ይኰርዕዎሙ: ኰርዐ — they beat them (3mp imperfect, G, kʷ-r-ʿ, + -ሆሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ይወርድ: ወረደ — it will descend (3ms imperfect, G, w-r-d)
glossary.ይደፍነከ: ደፈነ — it will cover, bury you (3ms subjunctive, G, d-f-n, + -ከ 'you')
glossary.ይጸብሕ: ጸብሐ — it will dawn (3ms subjunctive, G, ṣ-b-ḥ)
glossary.ገበርከ: ገብረ — you have done (2ms perfect, g-b-r)
glossary.ገቢረ: ገብረ — to do, doing (infinitive/verbal noun of ገብረ, accusative)
glossary.ገጾሙ: ገጽ — their faces (noun + -ሆሙ '3mp their', written ገጾሙ)
glossary.ጸብሐ: ጸብሐ — it dawned, became morning (3ms perfect, G, ṣ-b-ḥ)
